verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Gumloop publishes an llms.txt at docs.gumloop.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It contains a structured index linking to markdown versions of the doc pages (e.g., index.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant or usage guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
